title: bgsd Verification Report
description: Output contract for bgsd-verify: per-criterion verdicts, defect list, screenshot index, driver-ladder audit, environment context, and a top-level verdict. REPORT-01..03.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the report was assembled.

verdict.description: Top-level verdict. FAIL if any criterion failed or a critical/high defect exists. ERROR if the run was blocked or encountered an unrecoverable error. PASS otherwise.

environment.description: Environment metadata captured at run time. REPORT-03.

port.description: TCP port the app was served on (null if a full URL was provided without --boot).

db.description: DATABASE_URL used during the run (may be redacted; null if not applicable).

node_env.description: Value of NODE_ENV during the run.

build_mode.description: Build mode — 'development' or 'production'. Affects console_reliable interpretation.

url.description: The target URL that was verified.

criteria.description: Per-criterion verification results. One entry per acceptance criterion. REPORT-01.

defects.description: Actionable defects detected during the run. REPORT-02.

screenshots.description: Sparse screenshot index: initial load + defect evidence only. Not every step. REPORT-02.

driver_ladder.description: Audit of which rungs of the verification ladder ran and how many findings each produced. REPORT-03.

criterion_result.description: Verification result for a single acceptance criterion.

source.description: Where the criterion came from: a file path or 'inline'.

driver.description: Which rung of the driver ladder produced the deciding evidence. 'none' when the criterion was skipped or no evidence was collected.

evidence.description: Raw evidence backing the verdict. May be null (skip), a string description, or a structured object from the capture.

source.description: Which rung of the driver ladder surfaced this defect.

evidence.description: Raw evidence from the capture (console entry, network entry, DOM node, screenshot path, etc.).

criterion_id.description: The criterion this defect is mapped to, or null if it is a global defect not tied to a specific criterion.

screenshot.description: A screenshot captured during the run (sparse: initial load or defect evidence only).

path.description: Relative path to the screenshot file (relative to the run directory).

ladder_rung.description: Audit entry for a single driver-ladder rung.

ran.description: Whether this rung was executed during the run.

findings.description: Number of actionable findings this rung produced.
